paras.en: Saint John Greer Ervine, was born on Dec. 28, 1883, Belfast, Ireland and died on Jan. 24, 1971, London, England. He is a British playwright, novelist, and critic. Ervine’s best-known plays are Mixed Marriage (1911), Jane Clegg (1913), and John Ferguson (1915). After World War I, Ervine settled in London and became a drama critic for The Observer. He wrote books on drama as The Organized Theatre (1924) and The Theatre in My Time (1933). His later plays comedies such as The First Mrs. Fraser (1928), a rousing London success; Robert’s Wife (1937), and Private Enterprise (1947). Ervine also wrote biographies of William Booth, Oscar Wilde, and George Bernard Shaw. His novels include Francis Place, The Tailor of Charing Cross (1912) and Alice and a Family (1915).
paras.ur: سینٹ جان گیئر ارواین 28 دسمبر 1883 کو بیلفاسٹ، آئرلینڈ میں پیدا ہوئے اور 24 جنوری 1971 کو لندن، انگلینڈ میں وفات پائی۔ وہ ایک برطانوی ڈراما نگار، ناول نگار اور نقاد ہیں۔ ارواین کے سب سے مشہور ڈرامے Mixed Marriage (1911)، Jane Clegg (1913) اور John Ferguson (1915) ہیں۔ پہلی جنگِ عظیم کے بعد ارواین لندن میں آباد ہوئے اور دی آبزرور کے ڈراما نقاد بن گئے۔ انہوں نے ڈرامے پر The Organized Theatre (1924) اور The Theatre in My Time (1933) جیسی کتابیں لکھیں۔ ان کے بعد کے مزاحیہ ڈراموں میں The First Mrs. Fraser (1928)، جو لندن میں شاندار کامیاب رہا؛ Robert’s Wife (1937) اور Private Enterprise (1947) شامل ہیں۔ ارواین نے ولیم بوتھ، آسکر وائلڈ اور جارج برنارڈ شا کی سوانح عمریاں بھی لکھیں۔ ان کے ناولوں میں Francis Place، The Tailor of Charing Cross (1912) اور Alice and a Family (1915) شامل ہیں۔
paras.ps: سینټ جان ګیر ارواین د ۱۸۸۳ کال د دسمبر په ۲۸ په بیلفاسټ، آیرلنډ کې زېږېدلی او د ۱۹۷۱ کال د جنوري په ۲۴ په لندن، انګلستان کې مړ شو. هغه یو بریتانوي ډرامه‌لیکوال، ناول‌لیکوال او انتقاد کوونکی دی. د ارواین تر ټولو مشهورې ډرامې Mixed Marriage (۱۹۱۱)، Jane Clegg (۱۹۱۳) او John Ferguson (۱۹۱۵) دي. له لومړۍ نړیوالې جګړې وروسته ارواین په لندن کې میشت شو او د آبزرور لپاره د ډرامې انتقاد کوونکی شو. هغه د ډرامې په اړه د The Organized Theatre (۱۹۲۴) او The Theatre in My Time (۱۹۳۳) غوندې کتابونه ولیکل. د هغه وروستۍ طنزیه ډرامې لکه The First Mrs. Fraser (۱۹۲۸)، چې په لندن کې ښه بریا وه؛ Robert’s Wife (۱۹۳۷) او Private Enterprise (۱۹۴۷) شامل دي. ارواین د ویلیم بوتهـ، اسکر وایلډ او جورج برنارډ شا ژوندلیکونه هم ولیکل. د هغه ناولونه Francis Place، The Tailor of Charing Cross (۱۹۱۲) او Alice and a Family (۱۹۱۵) شامل دي.

rows.en: The lines of a face are those noticeable folds in the skin which always develop as a person grows older. Quite often they are created by the person’s usual expression which, of course, tends to reflect his usual feelings and, consequently, his character. ‘Cruel lines in the face are lines which suggest cruelty of character. “about’ is here used in the meaning of ‘around’.

A bold-headed "About the author" paragraph (the textbook's own note; the titles of plays and books are printed in plain text) and a pink "Glossary and Notes" banner with eight entries printed as run-in headings (the entry word in bold italics followed by its meaning); they are shown here as a two-column table (Word / Meaning). The left edge of the scan clips the first letters of several lines (e.g. "asual visitor" for "casual visitor", "inconsequent", "retort" (printed "tort"), "kin" for "skin"); the missing letters are read from context. The author note has some unusual wording ("His later plays comedies such as…"); kept as printed. The Urdu and Pashto texts are translations by us. A phone-number strip, the watermark and border lines are excluded; pink corner flags are excluded. The page number 222 is printed in a diamond at the foot.
